response.sql: WITH counts_by_type AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders o INNER JOIN riskandmargin rm ON o.recordvault = rm.ordervault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_count_cte AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count FROM counts_by_type), above_avg_types AS (SELECT ct.order_count, ac.avg_count, ct.order_count - ac.avg_count as excess FROM counts_by_type ct CROSS JOIN avg_count_cte ac WHERE ct.order_count > ac.avg_count) SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_of_above_avg_counts, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_amount FROM above_avg_types
